abstract: The International Labour Organization's 2025 report on platform labour examines employment trends and earnings dynamics in the gig economy. The report documents significant earnings deterioration among platform workers in knowledge-based roles, with median earnings declining 15-25% since 2023 across writing, translation, and data labeling sectors.
keyFindings: Platform workers in writing, translation, and data labeling experienced median earnings declines of 15-25% since 2023.
